issues.title: Company navigation says "Investors relations"
issues.summary: The Company navigation label reads "Investors Investors relations, reports and filings," which contains a grammar/copy error in a shared navigation element.
issues.recommended_action: Change the shared label to "Investor Relations" and verify the correction across pages that reuse the same navigation component.

issues.title: Primary contact form was not observable in accessible text capture
issues.summary: The page asks visitors to "Tell us a bit about your goals," but the review could not observe any form fields, field labels, or submit control in the page capture, so the main conversion form may be hidden, embedded without accessible text, or failing to load.
issues.recommended_action: Manually verify that the form renders reliably, exposes labeled inputs and a submit action, and remains usable for keyboard and assistive-tech users.

issues.title: Featured resource cards rely on generic "See more" CTAs
issues.summary: Multiple promoted resources use the same vague CTA text ("See more"), which weakens scanability and makes it harder to predict the destination type before clicking.
issues.recommended_action: Use destination-specific CTA copy such as "Read the report," "Watch the webinar," or "Open guide."

issues.title: Blog filter taxonomy reads as one collapsed string
issues.summary: The year and topic filters are exposed as a long run-on string (for example "2009#NiCETalks ..."), which likely hurts readability and linearized navigation for assistive technology.
issues.recommended_action: Ensure each filter option has clear visible separation and an accessible label when the control set is read linearly.

issues.title: Hero copy misspells "preferable" as "preferrable"
issues.summary: The product hero reads "Personal, preferrable, AI-powered connections," which contains a spelling error in a prominent conversion area.
issues.recommended_action: Correct the word to "preferable" and recheck the hero copy on desktop and mobile.
